{{incomplete|needs=Release dates of non-Beyond movies; catalogue number of Blu-ray of M13 and M15}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the [[Pokémon movie]]s in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}}. DVD releases are for {{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}, {{wp|Blu-ray}} releases are for {{wp|Blu-ray Region Code|Blu-ray Region B}} (although they may be playable in other regions), and all releases are {{wp|PAL}}. ==Single movie releases== ===''Mewtwo Strikes Back''=== ''[[M01|Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back]]'' was initially released on home video in Australia by {{wp|Warner Bros.}} Both the VHS and DVD release include the [[Pikachu short]] ''[[PK01|Pikachu's Vacation]]''. The promotional {{Trading Card Game}} card {{TCG ID|Wizards Promo|Mewtwo|3}} was included in early releases of the DVD. It was released on VHS in Australia with the catalogue number 18270. It was released on DVD in Australia with the catalogue number DVS18270. These releases use a 4:3 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The DVD has English, French, Italian, Dutch, and Portuguese audio; with optional English, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, English for the hearing impaired, and Italian for the hearing impaired closed captions. The DVD release includes the following extras: * Commentary audio track by Director [[Michael Haigney]] and Producer [[Norman J. Grossfeld]] * [[The Story of Mewtwo's Origin]] (first two minutes of ''[[The Uncut Story of Mewtwo's Origin]]'') * Music video for {{wp|M2M (band)|M2M}}'s "{{wp|Don't Say You Love Me (M2M song)|Don't Say You Love Me}}" (the movie's ending theme) * Theatrical trailer of the movie * Preview of ''[[M02|The Power of One]]'' * "Ash's Journey" * DVD-ROM features The VHS had [[The Story of Mewtwo's Origin]] (first two minutes of ''[[The Uncut Story of Mewtwo's Origin]]'') added to the beginning of the film. It was re-released on DVD in a Collector's Edition Tin in Australia and New Zealand by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} on December 2, 2015 with the catalogue number BHE6417. It was released on DVD in standard case by Beyond Home Entertainment in Australia on February 3, 2016 and in New Zealand on February 17, 2016 with the catalogue number BHE6679. These releases do not include a Pikachu short or any other special features. These releases use a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. It was re-released once again by [https://shock.com.au Shock Entertainment] in Australia on February 3, 2021 and in New Zealand on March 24, 2021 with an updated cover and the catalogue number KAL5556B. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Kanto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Kanto}} |image1=Mewtwo Strikes Back VHS.png |size1=x200px |caption1=VHS cover |image2=Mewtwo Strikes Back DVD.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover (Warner Bros.; online) |image3=Mewtwo Strikes Back Region 4 2000 Physical DVD Cover.png |size3=x200px |caption3=DVD cover (Warner Bros.; physical) |image4=Pokémon The First Movie DVD - Collector's Edition.png |size4=x200px |caption4=DVD cover (Beyond Collector's Edition) |image5=Pokémon The First Movie Region 4 DVD.png |size5=x200px |caption5=DVD cover (Beyond) |image6=M01Region42021ReleaseCover.jpg |size6=x200px |caption6=DVD cover (Shock) }} ===''The Power of One''=== {{incomplete|section|needs=VHS aspect ratio}} ''[[M02|Pokémon: The Movie 2000 - The Power of One]]'' was initially released on home video in Australia by {{wp|Warner Bros.}} Both the VHS and DVD release include the [[Pikachu short]] ''[[PK04|Pikachu's Rescue Adventure]]''.
